diagnosis: Check C6, which is supposed to depend on the hidden fact PF1 (the 0800 Dock 1 appointment), passed in three rollouts despite the decision-maker having no access to PF1. In these rollouts, the model defaulted to setting 'carrier_coordination_required' to true as a generic safety/coordination precaution, making the check satisfiable without the specific timing information provided by PF1.

C6.why: The confirmed 0800 Dock 1 appointment changes the medical unloading start to exactly 0800 at Dock 1. Because the carrier will hold the temperature-controlled load only until 1000, the distribution platoon must coordinate directly with the carrier to ensure unloading is completed before the 1000 deadline; carrier coordination is therefore required, not optional.
